checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored (added a testability criterion this cycle, motivated by Cycle 1's untested win-condition gap). Photon Reflect (grid laser-reflection puzzle, procedurally generated + solvability-checked) selected; Orbit Duel: AI Rival kept as runner-up/fallback.

Pure-function core (simulate() beam physics, generateLevel() with backward-from-solution generation + solvability check) separated from render/input/DOM, single-file HTML5 canvas architecture (game/cycle2/index.html), test hook pattern reused from Cycle 1 (getters for reassigned refs). Testing plan explicitly targets closing Cycle 1's win-condition-not-automated gap via a scripted-solution E2E test.

Self-contained playable prototype: Photon Reflect grid laser-puzzle, no build step, no external assets/deps. Pure logic (simulate/generateLevel/isSolved) exposed via window.__photonReflect test hook alongside live getters (grid/level/litCells/solved/failed/placementsUsed), matching Cycle 1's getter pattern for reassigned references.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium tests, all PASS: load smoke test, 6/6 simulate() unit tests (straight pass, both mirror orientations, splitter, wall block, infinite-loop guard), generateLevel() solvability sanity across 300 seeds (0 failures), end-to-end WIN test via scripted replay of the generator's own solution, end-to-end LOSE test + reset. This closes Cycle 1's flagged gap: win condition is now exercised end-to-end by an automated test, not just code review.

followUps: Photon Reflect: human/manual fun-tuning of generated level difficulty (constants: grid size, MIN/MAX_SOLUTION, MIN/MAX_TARGETS, EXTRA_EDITABLE decoys) not yet human-playtested -- top candidate follow-up if this concept is revisited.
Photon Reflect: consider a level-select/progression system (currently one generated level + 'New Level' button, no difficulty curve) if revisited.

Cycle 1 follow-ups still open and deferred: human/manual playtest of Orbit Duel for feel/balance tuning; 'Orbit Duel: AI Rival' remains a good future-cycle candidate (scored 2nd in this cycle's evaluation).
